verdict.rationale: CIPO's own patents page links to a directory for finding a licensed patent agent, which points to a sanctioned representative rail through which a provider can act for a company. The evidence is only that one link title. It does not document how agents are appointed or authorized, what they can do, or whether trademark agents or MyCIPO account delegation exist. Missing for 10: documentation of how an agent or representative is appointed and authorized, the scope of what an agent may do, a trademark-agent equivalent, delegated MyCIPO account access, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
